q-175684.name: Question 2
q-175684.worked_solution:
We replace $x$ with $4$ in the expression and simplify as much as possible.

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{5x-4}{x-2} & = \\ \frac{5(4)-4}{4-2} & = \\ \frac{16}{2} & = \\ 8\end{aligned}
$$

q-70116.name: Question 3
q-70116.worked_solution:
We replace $x$ with $2$ in the expression and simplify as much as possible.

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{2(x-3)}{4-x} & = \\ \frac{2(2-3)}{4-2} & = \\ \frac{2(-1)}{2} & = \\ \frac{\cancel{2}(-1)}{\cancel{2}} & = \\ -1\end{aligned}
$$

q-99873.worked_solution:
We replace $p$ with $-3$ in the above expression and simplify as much as possible.

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{p(5p-2)}{6(3p+8)} & = \\ \frac{(-3)(5(-3)-2)}{6(3(-3)+8)} & = \\ \frac{(-3)(-15-2)}{6(-9+8)} & = \\ \frac{(-3)(-17)}{6(-1)} & = \\ \frac{51}{(-6)} & = \\ -\frac{17}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

q-175875.name: Question 5
q-175875.worked_solution:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{3p}{10}+\frac{1}{p}= \\ \frac{3(5)}{10}+\frac{1}{5} & = \\ \frac{15}{10}+\frac{1}{5} & = \\ \frac{15}{10}+\frac{2}{10} & = \\ \frac{15+2}{10} & = \\ \frac{17}{10}\end{aligned}
